sentences.text: Hier, Sophie est allée à Paris avec son frère.
sentences.translation: Yesterday, Sophie went to Paris with her brother.

sentences.text: Ils ont pris le train le matin.
sentences.translation: They took the train in the morning.

sentences.text: D'abord, ils ont visité la tour Eiffel.
sentences.translation: First, they visited the Eiffel Tower.

sentences.text: Sophie a pris beaucoup de photos.
sentences.translation: Sophie took a lot of photos.

sentences.text: À midi, ils ont mangé un sandwich dans un parc.
sentences.translation: At noon, they ate a sandwich in a park.

sentences.text: L'après-midi, il a commencé à pleuvoir.
sentences.translation: In the afternoon, it started to rain.

sentences.text: Alors, ils sont entrés dans un musée.
sentences.translation: So they went into a museum.

sentences.text: Le soir, ils étaient fatigués mais très contents.
sentences.translation: In the evening, they were tired but very happy.

questions.question: How did they travel to Paris?
What did they do when it started to rain?
How did they feel in the evening?

sentences.text: Un nouveau voisin est arrivé la semaine dernière.
sentences.translation: A new neighbour arrived last week.

sentences.text: Il s'appelle Marc et il vient de Lyon.
sentences.translation: His name is Marc and he comes from Lyon.

sentences.text: Marc a beaucoup de cartons à monter.
sentences.translation: Marc has a lot of boxes to carry up.

sentences.text: Mon père a proposé de l'aider.
sentences.translation: My father offered to help him.

sentences.text: Ensemble, ils ont porté les meubles pendant deux heures.
sentences.translation: Together, they carried the furniture for two hours.

sentences.text: Pour dire merci, Marc nous a invités à dîner.
sentences.translation: To say thank you, Marc invited us to dinner.

sentences.text: Il a préparé un plat de son enfance.
sentences.translation: He prepared a dish from his childhood.

sentences.text: Maintenant, Marc est un bon ami de la famille.
sentences.translation: Now, Marc is a good friend of the family.

questions.question: How did Marc thank the family?
